idea-plugin.name: WaitLingo
idea-plugin.description:
WaitLingo helps you learn English while working in your IDE.

It shows short English-Turkish word pairs in the status bar and lets you open a lightweight popup with example sentences.

The goal is to turn small waiting moments in the IDE into calm, low-friction vocabulary practice.

  • English-Turkish vocabulary cards
  • Status bar word rotation
  • Two example sentences for every word
  • Lightweight popup UI
  • Works fully offline
  • No telemetry
  • No account required
  • No network request
